name: CV Whitezone
description: Default CV-vs-job template. Treat contact details, names, profile links, and plain identity fields as context, not claims.
instructions: Focus on work-experience, skill, leadership, education, and measurable achievement claims. Do not penalize email addresses, phone numbers, names, locations, or profile URLs unless they are written as evidence-backed claims.

name: Sales Claim Whitezone
description: Default sales-vs-source template. Separate promotional wording from factual product, metric, and proof claims.
instructions: Check measurable claims, superiority claims, guarantees, named integrations, certifications, and performance numbers. Treat slogans and contact details as context unless they assert a factual result.

name: Pitch Deck Whitezone
description: Default pitch-deck template. Prioritize investor-facing traction, market, revenue, team, and technical proof claims.
instructions: Check metrics, growth, customer, team, partnership, market-size, and product-readiness statements. Keep harmless labels, URLs, emails, and presenter details out of unsupported-claim scoring.

name: Report Reference Whitezone
description: Default report-vs-reference template. Evaluate claims against citations, appendices, datasets, and supporting documents.
instructions: Check factual statements, figures, conclusions, trends, and cited assertions. Treat headings, author information, and reference metadata as context unless they make a substantive claim.
